svg.title: Effective take-rate across checkout & distribution rails
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-mor-vs-direct-fee-bars; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Effective take-rate across checkout & distribution rails; subtitle: Illustrative % platform & payment fee on a $100 digital order; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Percent of a $100 digital sale; excludes optional paid discovery boosts and state registration overhead.; caption: Direct Stripe has the lowest card fee but leaves global VAT/Wayfair nexus compliance on the seller; MoR platforms absorb tax liability for ~2% more.; stages: label: Direct Stripe + Tax; value: 3.7% / $3.70; numeric value: 3.7; detail: 2.9% + $0.30 card fee plus ~0.5% Stripe Tax; seller still owns state/VAT registrations.; label: MoR (Paddle / LS); value: 5.5% / $5.50; numeric value: 5.5; detail: 5% + $0.50 Merchant-of-Record fee; MoR acts as legal seller and remits global VAT/sales tax.; label: Gumroad Direct; value: 10.5% / $10.50; numeric value: 10.5; detail: 10% + $0.50 direct-link fee; simple starter rail but expensive above $10k/mo volume.; label: App Store In-App; value: 30.0% / $30.00; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Standard 30% mobile store commission (15% Small Business Program) vs Web2App external web checkout.

text.title: Effective take-rate across checkout & distribution rails
text.tspan: Effective take-rate across checkout & distribution rails

circle.title: label: Direct Stripe + Tax; value: 3.7% / $3.70; numeric value: 3.7; detail: 2.9% + $0.30 card fee plus ~0.5% Stripe Tax; seller still owns state/VAT registrations.
label: MoR (Paddle / LS); value: 5.5% / $5.50; numeric value: 5.5; detail: 5% + $0.50 Merchant-of-Record fee; MoR acts as legal seller and remits global VAT/sales tax.
label: Gumroad Direct; value: 10.5% / $10.50; numeric value: 10.5; detail: 10% + $0.50 direct-link fee; simple starter rail but expensive above $10k/mo volume.
label: App Store In-App; value: 30.0% / $30.00; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Standard 30% mobile store commission (15% Small Business Program) vs Web2App external web checkout.

text.title: Assumptions: Percent of a $100 digital sale; excludes optional paid discovery boosts and state registration overhead.
